caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass goblet placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The goblet has an ornate and intricate design characterized by a flared rim with undulating waves and scalloped edges. The bowl of the glass is decorated with elongated, vertical beveled facets that create a prismatic effect, and it narrows down to a more elaborately cut section at the base of the bowl. The stem is faceted and tapers towards the foot, which is circular and also features a pattern of radial cuts. The color of the glass is mostly clear with subtle shades of gray and light brown, which represent the reflections and refractions within the glass. The drawing uses soft, delicate lines and shading to convey the transparency and reflective qualities of the glass. The only other elements are a small handwritten signature in the lower left corner of the paper.
title: Glass Celery Holder
